messages.author: 3b104dc6686d0c85
messages.subject: Re: Forecasting using renjin
parts:
Hi Lalitdutt,

it looks like your trying the use the forecast package from CRAN. Unfortunately this package is not supported in Renjin at this moment and probably will not be for the foreseeable future. This particular package uses C++ code, which we do not support. So unless you are using Renjin because your situation requires it, I suggest you use GNU R instead.

Maarten-Jan
